title: Create an interface design system
summary: Generate a coherent visual system with semantic tokens, component states, responsive rules, and agent guidance.
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original TriunaLabs workflow created to complement Laws of UX with deterministic system generation, semantic tokens, implementation guardrails, validation, and a reviewable specimen. The architecture was informed by public open-core design tools; no third-party code or datasets are included.
requirements: Python 3.10+ for deterministic generation and validation. Browser inspection is recommended for the standalone specimen. Optional decision providers and remote fonts require their own access and authorization.
examples: Create a calm, trustworthy interface system for a healthcare scheduling application and render the specimen.
Extract the established visual rules from these screenshots, mark inferred tokens, and generate a migration-safe design contract.
Evolve this design system for a denser operations dashboard without changing the brand palette.

preview.alt: Interface design system specimen with semantic colors, typography, controls, cards, spacing, and responsive rules.
